gloss: to be effective; to work; to be possible

definitions.gloss: to be effective, to work, to take effect
definitions.explanation: Describes something functioning properly or producing the intended effect. Used for medicine, brakes, air conditioning, seasoning, etc.

definitions.gloss: to be possible, to be able to do
definitions.explanation: Indicates that something can be done or is available as an option. Often used in the pattern ～が利く.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧{利|き}く。
⟦エアコン→エアコン：05282_eakon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{利|き}いて⟦いて→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{涼|すず}しい→涼しい：00674_suzushii⟧。
examples.english: The air conditioning is working and it's cool.

examples.english: It's maneuverable, so even narrow roads are fine.

notes:
Written with the kanji {利|き}く to distinguish from the homophones ⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧ (to listen/ask) and ⟦{効|き}く→効く：01932_kiku⟧ (to be effective — more focused on medicinal or chemical effects). In practice, {利|き}く and ⟦{効|き}く→効く：01932_kiku⟧ overlap considerably for sense 1, but {利|き}く covers the broader meaning of functioning or being available.

- {利|き}かない (negative)
- {利|き}きます (polite)
- {利|き}いた (past)
- {利|き}いて (te-form)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ブレーキ→ブレーキ：00022_bureeki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{利|き}く — the brakes work
- ⟦{融通|ゆうずう}→融通：10914_yuuzuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{利|き}く — to be flexible/adaptable
- ⟦{小回|こまわ}り→小回り：27781_komawari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{利|き}く — to be maneuverable
- ⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{利|き}く — to be considerate/attentive
- つぶし⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{利|き}く — to have versatile skills/qualifications
- ⟦{無理|むり}→無理：01558_muri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{利|き}く — to be able to push oneself
